# Falls Pointe Dentistry

> A comprehensive dental practice in Raleigh, NC offering general, cosmetic, restorative, and emergency dentistry services under the care of Dr. Ohm Patel, DDS, FAGD.

Falls Pointe Dentistry serves the North Raleigh community with advanced dental technology, patient-focused care, and flexible financing options. The practice specializes in cosmetic treatments like Invisalign and teeth whitening, restorative solutions including dental implants and dentures, and emergency care for urgent dental needs.

## Core Services

- [General Dentistry Services in Raleigh, NC](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/general-dentistry): General dentistry including cleanings, checkups, X-rays, and root canals
- [Cosmetic Dentist Raleigh, NC | Falls Pointe Dentistry](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/general-and-cosmetic-dentistry-north-raleigh-nc): Cosmetic dentistry services including teeth whitening, veneers, and Invisalign
- [Dental Implants in Raleigh, NC | Falls Pointe Dentistry](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/dental-implants-north-raleigh-nc): Permanent dental implants including All-on-4 and endosteal implant options
- [Emergency Dentist in Raleigh, NC | Emergency Dental](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/emergency-dental-care-north-raleigh-nc): Emergency dental treatment for loose fillings, injuries, and urgent dental issues
- [Invisalign® Raleigh, NC | Falls Pointe Dentistry](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/invisalign-clear-braces-north-raleigh-nc): Invisalign clear aligners for discreet teeth straightening with Dr. Ohm Patel
- [Dentures in Raleigh, NC | Financing Available](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/dentures-north-raleigh-nc): Partial and full dentures with financing options for tooth replacement

## Specialized Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry Raleigh, NC | Falls Pointe Dentistry](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/childrens-dentist-north-raleigh-nc): Pediatric dentistry with sealants, fluoride treatment, and family-friendly care
- [Sedation Dentist in Raleigh, NC | Falls Pointe Dentistry](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry options including nitrous oxide for anxiety-free dental visits
- [Tooth Extraction Raleigh, NC | Falls Pointe Dentistry](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/teeth-extractions-north-raleigh-nc): Tooth extraction services with aftercare and dental replacement options
- [Dental Implants in Raleigh, NC | Falls Pointe Dentistry](https://www.fallspointedentistry.com/services/oral-surgery-north-raleigh-nc): Oral surgery services for dental implants and tooth replacement procedures
